name: Andrés Ingi Jónsson
detail: Píratar MP 2016-2024; asked the finance minister in writing what a wealth tax on the 2013 model would raise for 2021-2023 (154th session, case 978). A request for a revenue estimate, not a call for the tax.

name: Bjarkey Olsen Gunnarsdóttir
detail: Left-Green MP; on 14 Sept 2017 said she would not argue against introducing an auðlegðarskattur. Not an endorsement; the party itself is recorded.

name: Indriði H. Þorláksson
detail: Former tax director; his Heimildin essays (2016, 2024) describe how the auðlegðarskattur and its repeal changed tax burdens without recommending the tax. Look for an explicit op-ed.
